source.author: verg
source.text: Hanc pro Palladio moniti, pro numine laeso effigiem statuere, nefas quae triste piaret.
source.text_original: Hanc pro Palladio moniti, pro numine laeso / effigiem statuere, nefas quae triste piaret.
source.text_english: Admonished to set up this image in place of Pallas and to atone for the insult done to the deity, as an expiation for the dreadful sin.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: sed tibi triste nefas fraternaque turbidus arma rex parat et saevos irarum concipit ignes.
reuse.text_original: sed tibi triste nefas fraternaque turbidus arma / rex parat et saevos irarum concipit ignes.
reuse.text_english: But for you, the king, in troubled fury, is preparing a grim crime and brotherly arms, and is kindling the savage fires of anger.
